blocks.en: Except for the minus sign in the exponent, the formula for the inverse Fourier transform agrees with that for the Fourier transform itself. To evaluate the integrals arising in Fourier transforms, complex contour deformations are often useful; for examples, see Problem~\ref{ex:fourier-gaussian-rational-transforms}.
blocks.zh: 除指数中的负号外, Fourier 逆变换公式与 Fourier 变换本身的公式一致. 计算 Fourier 变换中出现的积分时, 复积分路径变形常常很有用; 例子见 Problem~\ref{ex:fourier-gaussian-rational-transforms}.
